title: 第11章 不到三天成熟大丰收宝瓶空间第12章 酒楼掌柜不简单
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
“噗嗤~”
“嚎~”
云昊挥起砍柴刀，迅猛出击，准确无误砍在了大野猪脖子上。
在一声惊嚎之后，野猪颇大的脑袋，被一刀齐齐砍断滚落出去一米远。
巨大的无头尸体，倒下后还在抽搐。
鲜血哗啦啦喷流出来，侵入进来泥土中。
如此变故，领头的大野猪被云昊砍掉脑袋。
身后八头较小的野猪，顿时惊散逃跑。
云昊一击得手，无比轻松。
当初去镇上，遇到流民打劫，流民都杀了四个。
现在猎杀野猪，毫无压力。
在他眼里，这些野猪都是肉。
岂能放过？
如恶狼盯上绵羊。
一路追上去，就是一通咔咔乱砍。
有五头野猪被他砍杀。
跑掉了三头，他没去追，倒不是杀不了，而是三头野猪跑进了荆棘灌木中。
加上大野猪，五头小野猪，已经是大收获。
大小加起来也上千斤肉了，等天亮就拿去镇上卖掉，否则天热肉就坏了。
将几头野猪堆在了一起。

看看天色还有几个时辰天亮，云昊继续吐纳……
等天亮之后，迎着清晨的第一缕阳光云昊睁开了眼睛。
一夜吐纳呼吸，感觉小腹为主的气流又壮大了一些。
身体状态比昨天还好。
起身活动了一下筋骨，浑身发出噼里啪啦的作响声。
全身舒爽。
一抬头看向田地，满眼都是金灿灿一片。
好家伙，这一夜过去，稻谷全部成熟。
看着长长的稻穗，云昊抓了一株放在手里一撮，一粒粒稻谷捏了一大把，放在嘴里咬破了一粒，雪白的大米出现。
完全成熟。
云昊开始收割。
花了两个时辰多全部收割腾出来谷子，一亩地云昊得到了足足八大麻袋。
粗算一下都有八石谷子。
一石十斗，比寻常水田都多几倍。
这绝对是巨大丰收。
宝瓶水浇灌种植的农作物，不仅颗粒丰满还产量高。
content_en:
"Pfft~"
"Howl~"
Yun Hao swung the woodcutter and struck out quickly, accurately hitting the big wild boar's neck.
After a scream, the wild boar's huge head was chopped off with a knife and rolled one meter away.
A huge headless corpse, still twitching after falling.
Blood spurted out and invaded the soil.
Due to such a turn of events, the leading wild boar was beheaded by Yun Hao.
The eight smaller wild boars behind him immediately scattered and fled.
Yun Hao succeeded with one blow, extremely easily.
When I first went to town, I encountered refugees robbing me, and they killed four of them.
Now hunt wild boars stress-free.
In his eyes, these wild boars are just meat.
How can you let it go?
Like a wolf eyeing a sheep.
The whole process of catching up was just a series of hacking attacks.
Five wild boars were killed by him.
Three wild boars ran away, but he didn't chase them. It wasn't that they couldn't be killed, but the three wild boars ran into the thorn bushes.
Including the big wild boar and five small wild boars, it was already a big harvest.
The total size adds up to a thousand kilograms of meat. When daybreak, take it to the town and sell it, otherwise the meat will spoil in the hot weather.
Several wild boars were piled together.
Looking at how many hours there would be until dawn, Yun Hao continued to talk...
After dawn, Yunhao opened his eyes to the first ray of sunshine in the morning.
After breathing in and out all night, I felt that the air flow mainly in the lower abdomen became stronger.
My physical condition is better than yesterday.
He stood up and stretched his muscles, making a crackling sound all over his body.
Feeling refreshed all over.
When I looked up at the fields, my eyes were filled with gold.
Good guy, after this night, the rice is all ripe.
Looking at the long ears of rice, Yun Hao grabbed one and put a handful in his hand. He pinched a handful of rice grains and put it in his mouth and bitten a grain. Snow-white rice appeared.
Completely mature.
Yunhao began to harvest.
It took more than two hours to harvest all the millet, and Yun Hao got eight large sacks from one acre of land.
At a rough calculation, there are eight stones of millet.
One stone weighs ten buckets, which is several times more than an ordinary paddy field.
This is definitely a huge harvest.
Crops grown with water from Aquarius water not only have plump grains but also have high yields.
